title: Tikhonov regularization
description: Documented public inverse problem method (Andrey Tikhonov (method)) for the Inverse Problem Engine capability area.
body:
Tikhonov regularization is a documented inverse problem method from Andrey Tikhonov (method). The foundational regularization method for ill-posed inverse problems, stabilizing parameter inference from noisy measurements.

How it works: It works by solving the 2x2 linear system with Cramer's rule and reporting the residual norm to confirm the solution actually satisfies the measurements.

Documented uses of this capability area include discovering physical laws from experimental data, verifying mathematical proofs, quantifying simulation uncertainty, and calibrating models to measurements.
